name_zh: 阿根廷·卡洛斯·梅内姆：改革货币板与私有化赦免里奥哈腐败
name_en: Argentina Carlos Menem: Reform Currency Board & Privatization Amnesty Rioja Corruption
description_zh: 卡洛斯·梅内姆 (1930-2021) 阿根廷总统 (1989-1999)，货币板制度1比1锚定美元遏制恶性通胀，大规模私有化国企，赦免军政府/庇隆主义者罪行，里奥哈家族腐败丑闻，1999年交权德拉鲁阿。
description_en: Carlos Menem (1930-2021) Argentina President (1989-1999), currency board 1-to-1 dollar peg tamed hyperinflation, massive privatization, pardoned junta/Peronists crimes, Rioja family corruption scandal, 1999 handover De la Rua.
reason_zh: 梅内姆代表新自由主义如何通过货币板与私有化快速稳定经济，展示了赦免过去暴行如何为转型提供政治润滑剂却埋下腐败种子，其货币板崩溃引发2001年阿根廷最大危机。
reason_en: Menem represents how neoliberalism rapidly stabilizes economy through currency board and privatization, demonstrating how pardoning past atrocities provides political lubricant for transition but seeds corruption, his currency board collapse triggered 2001 Argentina worst crisis.
steps_zh: 研究梅内姆早年里奥哈州长与庇隆主义者身份
分析1991年可兑换法货币板1比1锚定美元
探讨石油/电信/航空私有化与赦免法案通过
评估里奥哈家族腐败与1999年交权德拉鲁阿
总结改革货币板私有化赦免里奥哈腐败对阿根廷2001危机的根源铺垫
steps_en: Study Menem early La Rioja Governor and Peronist identity
Analyze 1991 Convertibility Law currency board 1-to-1 dollar peg
Explore oil/telecom/aviation privatization and pardon laws passage
Evaluate Rioja family corruption and 1999 handover De la Rua
Summarize reform currency board privatization amnesty Rioja corruption root cause for Argentina 2001 crisis
expected_zh: 理解货币板如何作为通胀止痛药掩盖结构性失衡，掌握赦免与私有化双重转型代价的长期累积，评估梅内姆遗产对阿根廷周期性危机的深度历史责任。
expected_en: Understand how currency board as inflation painkiller masks structural imbalances, grasp pardon and privatization dual transition costs long-term accumulation, evaluate Menem legacy deep historical responsibility for Argentine cyclical crises.
case_zh: 1989 总统；1991 货币板；1999 交权；2021 逝世。改革货币板私有化赦免腐败范式永存。
case_en: 1989 President; 1991 currency board; 1999 handover; 2021 death. Reform currency board privatization amnesty corruption paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Currency board; privatization; pardon; hyperinflation cure; 2001 crisis root
